source_instruction: Of the four lower division requirements (American Studies 10 plus three courses from the list below), only two need to be completed before applying to the major.
note: Adviser review needed: the template lists three introductory courses, while the program text describes one introductory requirement. These courses are taken at Berkeley; the checklist does not resolve substitutions or alternatives automatically.

source_instruction: Choose three courses from the list of acceptable courses (with no more than two courses from any one department).
note: Choose three listed courses, with no more than two from any one Berkeley department. Adviser-approved substitutes require separate review.
